description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultGenderPrefTracker class, which manages user preferences related to default emoji gender settings in the application. It tests default values, preference updates, and disposal behavior.

classes.name: DefaultGenderPrefTrackerTest
classes.description: Test class for DefaultGenderPrefTracker, verifying default behavior, preference updates, and disposal.

methods.name: getDefaultGender
methods.description: Tests retrieving the default gender preference, including default null, specific values, invalid values, and randomness.

methods.name: testDispose
methods.description: Tests the disposal behavior of the tracker, ensuring it stops updating after being disposed.
